newsitem.title: USA: SEC official urges fund industry reform - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: SEC official urges fund industry reform - WSJ.

text.p: A top Securities and Exchange Commission official warned the fund industry in a recent speech that despite the industry's biggest year ever, vigilance and reform is called for, The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.

Barry Barbash, director of the SEC's Division of Investment Management, warned that investor's trust in mutual funds could easily erode if the industry doesn't tackle issues such as portfolio manager wrongdoing and the seemingly endless rise in mutual fund management fees, the story says.
Barbash gave his speech earlier in December to a Washington conference on mutual fund operations that was closed to the press, the story says.
Barbash said it would be "bad business" for the fund industry "simply to rest on its laurels," the story says.
